titulo_es: Maintain the preposition of the verb

fidarsi.consejo: The pronominal verb governing the «di» preposition.

texto: **Parlare di** → * l-argemento di cui parliamo * (the subject we are talking about).
**Contare su** → * the person your cui puoi will count * (the person you can count on).
**Lavorare a** → * il progetto a cui dedigo il mio tempo * (the project to which I dedicate my time).
Unlike «il quale / la quale / i quali / le quali», «cui» never changes shape according to gender or number: * gli amici with cui esco *, * le colleche con cui collabo *.

filas: la persona di cui mi fido
the issues on which I think
gli amici su cui puoi contare
the friends you can count on

frases.it: Chi è il nuovo socio di cui mi hai parlato ieri?
frases.es: ¿Quién es el nuevo socio del que me hablaste ayer?
frases.en: Who's the new partner you told me about yesterday?

frases.it: È un consulente esperto su cui possiamo contare per la gestione.
frases.es: Es un consultor experto con el que podemos contar para la gestión.
frases.en: He's an expert consultant we can count on for management.

frases.it: Perfetto, è proprio il profilo a cui pensavo per questo incarico.
frases.es: Perfecto, es justo el perfil en el que pensaba para este encargo.
frases.en: Perfect, it's just the profile I was thinking about for this assignment.
analisis: the one I was thinking about

frases.it: I clienti con cui collabora regolarmente sono molto soddisfatti.
frases.es: Los clientes con los que colabora habitualmente están muy satisfechos.
frases.en: The customers you usually work with are very satisfied.

bloques.pregunta: Why is «di cui» used in Luca's first question?

opciones.texto: Because the verb «parlare» governs the «di» preposition to indicate the subject or person.
opciones.explicacion: Synthetic explanation of the prepositional regimen with relative.

opciones.texto: Because the «socio» noun always requires the «di» preposition.
opciones.explicacion: The preposition depends on the subordinate verb, not the antecedent.

opciones.texto: Because it replaces the grammatical subject of the main prayer.
opciones.explicacion: The relative pronoun introduces a dependent complement to the subordinate.

bloques.frase: La persona ___ cui puoi contare è sempre sincera.

opciones.explicacion: In Italian «contare su qualcuno» the «su» preposition is required.
«Contare di» does not express confidence and support in a third party.
It is not the right regime to express mutual support or trust.

bloques.pregunta: What does Anna describe about the new partner?
bloques.frase: I clienti con cui collabora regolarmente sono molto soddisfatti.

opciones.texto: The clients with whom you work on a regular basis are fully satisfied.
opciones.explicacion: Accurate context translation of the «collaborare con» regime.

opciones.texto: The customers to whom it sends invoices have filed formal complaints.
opciones.explicacion: It completely distinguishes the positive and professional content of the phrase.

opciones.texto: The directors who hire workers ask for a prior interview.
opciones.explicacion: Invents a non-existent content in the subordinate prayer.

bloques.pregunta: What preposition does the verb «fidarsi» require when building a relative sentence with «cui»?

opciones.explicacion: Wrong construction that does not correspond to the pronominal verb.
It does not reflect the regulatory regime of trust in Italian.

bloques.frase: La persona su cui puoi contare
bloques.traduccion: The person you can count on
bloques.explicacion: Order the terms of perifrase with relative.

bloques.frase: Questo è l'incarico professionale ___ cui aspiravo da tempo.

opciones.explicacion: The verb «aspirare» requires the «a»: «aspirare a un incarico» preposition.
Although in Spanish it is sometimes said «for which», in Italian the regime is «aspirare a».
It has no syntactic correspondence with the verb of aspiration or goal.

bloques.pregunta: What is the right way for «the partners I work with»?

opciones.explicacion: «con» preposition followed by the relative invariable «cui».
Wrong bottom with preposition postponed at the end.

opciones.texto: Le colleghe a cui lavoro insieme.
opciones.explicacion: redundant and incorrect construction against «con cui».

intro: While **che** assumes direct functions without prior link, any preposition-introduced plugin requires the relative pronoun invariable **cui**. The chosen preposition depends exclusively on the verb of the subordinate prayer.
